name: singlet_trajectory_root_identification
title: Root or start-state identification
description: Chooses the root cell or cluster that sets the origin and direction of pseudotime and fate for a developmental process. The default method is manual: pass root_cell or root_cluster chosen from progenitor markers or the earliest timepoint. Automatic candidates from CytoTRACE-style potency, diffusion extremes and Palantir early-cell are ranked and cross-checked. Do not let it choose a root silently, because no benchmark validates automatic root choice.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

root_method.description: Root method. manual anchors on root_cell or root_cluster; palantir_early needs root_cell; dpt_extreme and cytotrace choose from the data.

root_cell.description: Obs name of an anchor cell: the root for manual, the early cell for palantir_early.

root_cluster.description: Obs label of an anchor cluster; its medoid cell in PCA space becomes the root for manual.

n_root_candidates.description: Number of ranked root candidates written to uns/root_candidates.

cytotrace.description: CytoTRACE-style gene-count potency score, also computed as a cross-check for every method.

layer.description: Expression layer for the gene-correlation score; CellRank default.

aggregation.description: Aggregation over the top correlated genes.

n_genes.description: Number of top positively correlated genes averaged into the score.

palantir.description: Palantir early-cell options, used by palantir_early only.

use_early_cell_as_start.description: Start from root_cell itself rather than the nearest boundary cell.

dpt.description: Diffusion-extreme options, used by dpt_extreme only.

component.description: Diffusion component index used to pick the extreme cell; index 0 is trivial and excluded.

extreme.description: Take the minimum or maximum of the chosen component as the root.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for Palantir waypoint sampling; the other methods are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/root. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: root_method, root_cell, root_cluster, candidates (score and cluster) and cluster_agreement. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
